department.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

criteria.account: login, password, profile, permissions, deleting the account

criteria: not urgent: a question or minor annoyance
soon: something is broken but there is a workaround
blocking: work or money is stopped right now

churn_risk.instructions: Does the customer threaten to cancel, leave or switch to a competitor?

criteria.true: the customer says they will cancel, leave, or move to another product
criteria.false: no threat to cancel or leave
